Can you tell me your age and whether you have noticed these

Patient: I’m 44 years old. I first noticed the small, non-itchy bumps on my left thigh about three weeks ago, and I haven’t had any fever or cough—just this ongoing fatigue and feeling unwell for a few months.
Can you describe what the bumps look like in more
They’re small bumps on my left thigh, kind of clustered together, and they don’t itch or hurt. I’d say they look like raised spots under the skin, and I haven’t noticed much change in color.

“No, I haven’t had any unexplained weight loss or night sweats. I’ve also not had fevers, cough, or shortness of breath—just the persistent fatigue and malaise for a few months.”

Patient: I haven’t noticed similar bumps anywhere else—only on my left thigh. The bumps have stayed localized there over these last few weeks.
